messages.content: 你能先幫我找一個素食，主菜的食譜嗎？並且能在30分鐘內準備好嗎？之後，能否請你找出重力的科學發現的詳細資料，使用預設的方法？完成後，我也想知道使用同樣方法發現希格斯玻色子的相關資料。最後，能否幫我找一個能在45分鐘內準備的無麩質甜點食譜？

function.name: find_recipe
function.description: Find a recipe based on the dietary restrictions, recipe type, and time constraints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dietary_restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions e.g. vegan, vegetarian, gluten free, dairy free.

recipe_type.description: Type of the recipe. E.g. dessert, main course, breakfast.

time.description: Time limit in minutes to prep the meal.

function.name: science_history_get_discovery_details
function.description: Retrieve the details of a scientific discovery based on the discovery name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discovery.description: The name of the discovery, e.g. Gravity

method_used.description: The method used for the discovery, default value is 'default' which gives the most accepted method.

The user wants:

1. Find a recipe based on dietary restrictions, recipe type, and time constraints. They want a vegetarian main course that can be prepared in 30 minutes. So we need to call the function find_recipe with dietary_restrictions="vegetarian", recipe_type="main course", time=30.

2. Retrieve details of a scientific discovery: "Gravity" using default method. So call science_history_get_discovery_details with discovery="Gravity" and method_used default (so we can omit or pass default). The function signature says method_used?: string, default value is 'default' which gives the most accepted method. So we can pass method_used="default" or omit. We'll pass method_used="default".

3. Retrieve details of a scientific discovery: "Higgs boson" using same method. So call science_history_get_discovery_details with discovery="Higgs boson" and method_used="default".

4. Find a recipe for a gluten-free dessert that can be prepared in 45 minutes. So call find_recipe with dietary_restrictions="gluten free", recipe_type="dessert", time=45.
